players.product: electrical distributor - transformer buyer (HICO America customer)

quarterly_data.signal: Record quarter: sales reached $6.7 billion with both reported and organic growth of 13%, a fourth consecutive quarter of double-digit sales growth, driven by an estimated 3% price benefit and solid volume growth across all three business units; growth was fueled by data centers with mid-single-digit growth excluding data center
quarterly_data.figure: sales $6.7B, +13% reported and organic; ~3% price; ex-data-center mid-single-digit growth

quarterly_data.signal: Data center sales reached $1.5 billion, up approximately 45% year-over-year; management describes a differentiated 'power to compute' model spanning the full data center lifecycle from the grid to the building to the rack and equipment

Data centers are a little over 20% of total Wesco sales on a trailing 12-month basis, with the remaining 75% to 80% of the portfolio diversified across infrastructure, power chain and reshoring demand
quarterly_data.figure: data center mix a little over 20% of total sales (trailing 12 months)

quarterly_data.signal: Record backlog for the third quarter in a row, up approximately 60% in the second quarter with record backlogs at all three business units: CSS backlog up approximately 95%, EES up approximately 30%, UBS up approximately 80%; growth fueled by multiyear customer commitments and providing high visibility into the second half
quarterly_data.figure: total backlog +~60% YoY; CSS +~95%, EES +~30%, UBS +~80%

quarterly_data.signal: Landmark multiyear grid services award from a hyperscale data center end-user customer, sold direct with no integrator; the customer name was not disclosed. The win expands UBS beyond utility and broadband into data center powered infrastructure, will ship over multiple years and is margin accretive to UBS; it drove the 80% UBS backlog growth (UBS backlog growth was still well above 20% to 30% excluding it). Grid services was a $300-plus-million business last year, organically built over five to six years, and has now posted three consecutive quarters of double-digit growth (Q4, Q1, Q2) with double-digit growth expected for the full year
quarterly_data.figure: grid services $300+ million business in 2025; three consecutive quarters of double-digit growth; multiyear hyperscaler award shipping over multiple years

quarterly_data.signal: CSS (Communications & Security Solutions) delivered reported and organic sales growth of 18% on continued data center momentum; sales for Wesco data center solutions increased approximately 45%, backlog ended up approximately 95% versus prior year, and adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 140 basis points to a record 10.2% - the first double-digit EBITDA margin quarter in CSS history
quarterly_data.figure: CSS sales +18%; data center solutions sales +~45%; CSS EBITDA margin 10.2% (+140bps)

quarterly_data.signal: EES (Electrical & Electronic Solutions) sales grew 11% with volume up approximately 6% and price approximately 5%; data center sales increased more than 70% year-over-year and now represent about 8% of EES sales, construction grew high-single-digit on robust data center infrastructure investments, OEM was up over 20% supported by semiconductor, electrification and data center customers; EES EBITDA margin expanded 110 basis points to 9.2% on record 24.4% gross margin
quarterly_data.figure: EES sales +11%; EES data center sales +>70% YoY, ~8% of EES sales; OEM +>20%; EES EBITDA margin 9.2%

quarterly_data.signal: UBS (Utility & Broadband Solutions) sales increased 7% with utility up mid-single-digit and broadband up mid-teens; the business returned to a 10% EBITDA margin, with public power competitive dynamics still a near-term margin headwind while grid services accelerates and is accretive at the operating margin line

Record adjusted EBITDA of $487 million, up 24%, with margin expanding 60 basis points to 7.3% of sales on 70 basis points of gross margin expansion; record adjusted earnings per share of $4.57, up 35%

Full-year 2026 outlook raised: organic sales growth of 9% to 11% (up from 5% to 8% previously), reported sales growth 10% to 12% with total reported sales of $26 billion at the midpoint, adjusted EBITDA margin 6.9% to 7.1% (an EBITDA raise of over $100 million at the midpoint), and adjusted diluted EPS of $16 to $17.50. The CSS data center sales outlook was raised to more than 30% year-over-year on continued strength in hyperscale and data center related demand
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 organic sales +9% to +11%; reported sales ~$26B; adjusted EPS $16-$17.50; CSS data center sales outlook raised to >30% YoY

quarterly_data.signal: Management says demand is outstripping supply across the electrical value chain: 'the constraint is power and labor' - power is the ultimate largest governor of data center construction, followed by construction labor, with a variety of in-front-of-the-meter and behind-the-meter power solutions being worked; Wesco says it is not yet seeing data center demand crowd out its own non-residential construction business, which grew high-single-digit

Pricing on electrical gear is back to business as usual: an approximately 3% overall price benefit in the quarter split CSS +1%, EES +5% (about a point of that commodity driven) and UBS +3%; supplier partners are being 'very measured' about price with nothing out of the ordinary to highlight
quarterly_data.figure: price +~3% overall; CSS +1%, EES +5% (~1pt commodity), UBS +3%

quarterly_data.signal: Acquisition of Singapore-based Newark Engineering Group closed July 1, 2026, adding mission-critical cooling and thermal management capability Wesco did not previously have - design engineering for mission-critical HVAC systems, in-house fabrication and assembly, installation and after-sales service - and strengthening presence in Southeast Asia and engagement earlier in the data center lifecycle

Third quarter outlook: preliminary July month-to-date sales per workday up approximately mid-teens percent, with third quarter sales expected to grow low double-digits year-over-year and adjusted EBITDA margin slightly lower sequentially on business mix; third quarter results are expected to be announced Thursday, October 29, 2026
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 sales growth low double-digits YoY; July MTD sales per workday +~mid-teens %
